_README: Paid Stripe sessions that reconcile_orders.py must NOT count as delivery failures.
This exists because a single known-bad historical order otherwise red-lights the probe
forever, and a permanently red probe is worse than no probe: a REAL paid-without-delivery
becomes indistinguishable from the known one.
* Only sessions listed here are excused. Everything else still fails.
* `reason` must be non-empty. An entry with a blank reason is itself an error, so this
file cannot be used to silence a failure without writing down why.
* Excuses apply ONLY to undelivered orders, never to an unreachable store. 'I could not
check' is not something anyone gets to wave through.
* An exception is an admission that a buyer did not get what they paid for. If the payer
was a real customer, refund them instead of listing them here.
